title: Prime Minister congratulates Himanshu Dhillon on winning Silver Medal at the Asian Games
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra has congratulated Himanshu Dhillon on winning the Silver Medal in the 10m Air Rifle Men’s Team event at the Asian Games 2026. Shri Modi said that India is proud of his performance.
Shri Modi posted on X:
A superb Silver for Himanshu Dhillon in the 10m Air Rifle Men’s event at the Asian Games! His calm under pressure and remarkable accuracy stood out. Congratulations to him on this excellent achievement. India is proud of his performance: PM @narendramodi
A superb Silver for Himanshu Dhillon in the 10m Air Rifle Men’s event at the Asian Games! His calm under pressure and remarkable accuracy stood out. Congratulations to him on this excellent achievement. India is proud of his performance: PM @narendramodi pic.twitter.com/Pc2iTSOHjY — PMO India (@PMOIndia) September 21, 2026
